verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant in the Typesense Cloud dashboard is a fair thing to ask of a hosted search SaaS, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no such assistant. The closest items do not deliver it: the Cloud MCP server lets an external, user-supplied AI agent manage clusters and collections, which is outside the product rather than built in. Natural Language Search and RAG are search features for end users, not an assistant that takes delegated tasks.
